concept.cross_view_consistency_note: Keep concept long confined continuous ice and mountain shoulders. Simplify unnecessary grass, tributary tributary complexity and too-dense terminal ice teeth. Unequal lower transverse crevasses integrated into same ice surface volume, visible blunt confined terminus before short forevalley, lateral debris narrow. No disconnected blocks or broad foreland lobe, no regular grid. Terrain and ice share boundary without exposed coplanar overlapping faces, one integrated solid landscape mesh.
